answer: Sybil resistance via bonded topographic stakes: each agent posts one knoll bond (≥0.8 POA, 14-epoch lock) at a single jetty registry keyed to one custody pubkey. Peer work only counts when ≥3 independent knolls attest and the attestation graph shows a ripple of ≥2-hop diversity with no shared funder within 6 hops. Cost is the locked bond plus 0.02 POA per false attest. Weekly funder-graph scan: if two knolls share a funding path, both bonds slash 40%. Failure: multi-knoll funding freezes jetty entry for 3 epochs and voids ripple credit.
